title: Stave Output Schema v0.1
description: Schema for Stave evaluation and verification output artifacts. Uses oneOf to distinguish evaluation results from verification (before/after) results.

oneOf.title: Evaluation Output
oneOf.description: Evaluation output: results from running controls against a set of observation snapshots.

kind.title: Output Kind
kind.description: Output kind discriminator. Value 'ASSESSMENT' indicates this is a standard security assessment.

run.title: Run Metadata
run.description: Metadata about the evaluation run including tool version, timing, and input parameters.

tool_version.title: Tool Version
tool_version.description: Version of the Stave CLI that produced this output.

offline.title: Offline Mode Flag
offline.description: Whether this evaluation was run in offline mode (no network access).

eval_time.title: Evaluation Timestamp
eval_time.description: Effective evaluation timestamp (RFC 3339). May be capped to the last snapshot's captured_at.

sla_threshold.title: SLA Threshold
sla_threshold.description: Maximum unsafe duration threshold used for this evaluation (e.g., 12h, 7d).

snapshots.title: Snapshot Count
snapshots.description: Number of observation snapshots loaded for this evaluation.

evaluated_state.title: Evaluated State
evaluated_state.description: Origin context of the evaluated snapshot: deployed (CI/CD), planned (IaC plan), or local (developer workstation).

input_hashes.title: Input Content Hashes
input_hashes.description: Content hashes of input files for reproducibility verification.

files.title: Per-File Hashes
files.description: Map of input file paths to their individual content hashes.

overall.title: Overall Content Hash
overall.description: Combined hash of all input files for quick reproducibility check.

policy_fingerprint.title: Policy Fingerprint
policy_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the active control set + chain definitions + engine eval-version. Stable across runs unless any of these change.

summary.title: Evaluation Summary
summary.description: Aggregate counts summarizing the evaluation results.

total_assets.title: Assets Evaluated Count
total_assets.description: Total number of assets evaluated across all controls.

exposed_resources.title: Currently Unsafe Count
exposed_resources.description: Number of assets currently in an unsafe state.

violations.title: Violation Count
violations.description: Number of findings that exceeded the max-unsafe threshold.

findings.title: Evaluation Findings
findings.description: List of control violations detected during evaluation.

items.title: Violation Finding
items.description: A single finding representing a control violation for a specific asset.

control_id.title: Control Identifier
control_id.description: Unique identifier of the violated control.

control_name.title: Control Name
control_name.description: Human-readable name of the violated control.

control_description.title: Control Description
control_description.description: Description of the unsafe condition detected by the control.

asset_id.title: Asset Identifier
asset_id.description: Unique identifier of the violating asset.

asset_vendor.title: Asset Vendor
asset_vendor.description: Cloud vendor of the violating asset.

source.title: Source File Reference
source.description: Source file reference for the asset definition.

line.title: Source Line Number
line.description: Line number in the source file.

evidence.title: Violation Evidence
evidence.description: Temporal and causal evidence supporting this finding.

control_compliance.title: Control Compliance Mappings
control_compliance.description: Single-string compliance framework mappings attached to the originating control (e.g., hipaa, pci_dss_v4.0, nist_800_53_r5).

control_compliance_ccm_v4.title: CCM v4 Mappings
control_compliance_ccm_v4.description: CSA CCM v4 control identifiers in DOMAIN-NN form, inherited from the originating control's compliance.ccm_v4 list.

remediation.title: Remediation Guidance
remediation.description: Remediation guidance for resolving this violation.

example.title: Remediation Example
example.description: Optional example of the remediation applied.

exempted_assets.title: Exempted Assets
exempted_assets.description: Assets that were excluded from evaluation (e.g., by scope exclusion rules).

asset_id.title: Asset Identifier
asset_id.description: Unique identifier of the exempted asset.

matched_pattern.title: Matched Exclusion Pattern
matched_pattern.description: Exclusion pattern that matched this asset.

remediation_groups.title: Remediation Groups
remediation_groups.description: Findings clustered by shared fix plan actions per asset. Reveals when multiple findings converge on the same remediation.

asset_id.title: Asset Identifier
asset_id.description: Unique identifier of the asset targeted by this remediation group.

asset_type.title: Asset Type
asset_type.description: Type of the asset targeted by this remediation group.

fix_plan.title: Fix Plan
fix_plan.description: The shared fix plan for all findings in this group.

contributing_controls.title: Contributing Controls
contributing_controls.description: Unique control IDs whose findings share this fix plan on this asset.

finding_count.title: Finding Count
finding_count.description: Total number of findings in this group (may exceed contributing_controls length when one control produces multiple findings).

coverage_posture.title: Alternative-Tool Coverage Posture
coverage_posture.description: Per-(tool, domain) coverage posture aggregated from each control's alternatives annotations. Outer key is the alternative tool's identifier (opaque string); inner key is the domain identifier declared by the inventory file. Omitted when no inventories are loaded.

additionalProperties.description: Per-domain coverage entries for one alternative tool.

covered.description: Number of distinct check IDs from the alternative tool that at least one Stave control covers (covered or partial).

total.description: Total checks declared by the alternative tool's inventory for this domain. Zero when no inventory is loaded for the tool.

not_covered_checks.description: Inventory check IDs not covered by any Stave control. Empty when no inventory is loaded for the tool.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Optional metadata about the evaluation run that complements the core summary.

skipped_controls.title: Skipped Controls
skipped_controls.description: Controls intentionally skipped by exception/exemption rules with reason.

control_id.title: Control Identifier
control_id.description: Unique identifier of the skipped control.

control_name.title: Control Name
control_name.description: Human-readable name of the skipped control.

status.title: Security State
status.description: Overall posture verdict — typically COMPLIANT, AT_RISK, or NON_COMPLIANT. Empty string permitted for envelopes the engine emits before posture classification.

risk_signals.title: Risk Signals
risk_signals.description: Items that have not yet violated their threshold but are approaching it (warning surface).

chain_findings.title: Chain Findings
chain_findings.description: Compound risk chains — combinations of single-control findings that together represent a higher-severity attack path.

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: Non-fatal engine issues encountered during evaluation (e.g. unresolved alias, missing observation field).

top_exposures.title: Top Exposures
top_exposures.description: Ranked summary of the highest-exposure findings/assets for prioritisation surfaces.

oneOf.title: Attestation Output
oneOf.description: Attestation output: results from comparing before and after observation snapshots to measure remediation progress.

kind.title: Output Kind
kind.description: Output kind discriminator. Value 'ATTESTATION' indicates this is a before/after remediation attestation.

run.title: Run Metadata
run.description: Metadata about the attestation run including tool version, timing, and snapshot counts.

tool_version.title: Tool Version
tool_version.description: Version of the Stave CLI that produced this output.

offline.title: Offline Mode Flag
offline.description: Whether this attestation was run in offline mode.

sla_threshold.title: SLA Threshold
sla_threshold.description: Maximum unsafe duration threshold used for both before and after evaluations.

before_snapshots.title: Before Snapshot Count
before_snapshots.description: Number of observation snapshots in the before (pre-remediation) set.

after_snapshots.title: After Snapshot Count
after_snapshots.description: Number of observation snapshots in the after (post-remediation) set.

summary.title: Attestation Summary
summary.description: Aggregate counts comparing before and after violation states.

previous_violations.title: Previous Violation Count
previous_violations.description: Number of violations in the before (pre-remediation) evaluation.

current_violations.title: Current Violation Count
current_violations.description: Number of violations in the after (post-remediation) evaluation.

remediated.title: Remediated Violation Count
remediated.description: Number of violations present before but absent after remediation.

open.title: Open Violation Count
open.description: Number of violations present in both before and after evaluations.

regressions.title: Regression Count
regressions.description: Number of new violations absent before but present after (regressions).

remediated.title: Remediated Violations
remediated.description: Violations that were present before remediation but are now resolved.

regressions.title: Regressions
regressions.description: New violations introduced after remediation (security regressions).

attestation_entry.title: Attestation Entry
attestation_entry.description: A single entry in an attestation result list (remediated, open, or regressions).
